example.title: Allegheny Portage Railroad, Lilly Culvert, State Route 53 over Burgoon Run

brief: Stone arch culvert of 1832 built for the Allegheny Portage Railroad and now under a state highway: an elliptical arch of 18 ft span and 6.5 ft rise in squared sandstone ashlar with a well-defined voussoir ring, headwalls 27 ft wide and 19 ft high between curving wing walls (42 ft overall), a timber-plank invert paving the stream bed through the barrel, and a simple timber post-and-rail fence along the road on top. Set deep in a wooded stream valley at the edge of a small town.
